body:
Maria C: quick sync — thinking about a 'traffic escrow' layer for pilot rollouts. proxy holds pilot responses until a lightweight quality-checker approves them, then releases to clients. This would let us A/B without exposing bad outputs. tradeoffs: added p95, extra compute, need to preserve KV/session affinity. thoughts?
Kev L: interesting. how does escrow keep latency bounded? can we stream partial tokens while escrow validates asynchronously?
Maria C: idea: stream tokens immediately but mark as 'untrusted' until escrow passes. client can opt-in to await 'trusted' result. fallback flips routing to stable model if escrow fails or times out.
Ash P: aligns w/ model-mirroring idea. we should mirror KV cache updates to stable model to avoid divergence on failover. downside: double KV writes and more memory.
Sangeeta R: observability & rollback triggers are key. propose two signals: (1) lightweight eval pass-rate over recent 100 requests, (2) latency+error SLO violations. combine with time-windowed hysteresis.
Kev L: solid. also need interface boundary between routing and validation. suggest Router -> Escrow -> Validator -> Release, where Validator is a pluggable service (python/go) with p95 < 50ms.
Maria C: proto policy snippet:
```json
{"policy": "pilot", "pass_rate": 0.98, "min_samples": 50, "max_hold_ms": 200}
```
Ash P: +1 but add an adaptive sampling knob so we don't validate every request at high qps. sample by user-session + stratified by prompt length.
Sangeeta R: failure modes we should document: validator slow, mirrored-kv inconsistency, partial release (some clients get trusted some don't). fallback plan: immediate traffic cut to stable; keep escrow in read-only to drain.
Kev L: infra cost note: escrow + validator scaling follows pilot qps. can we offload validator to serverless with warm pools? might help with cost but cold starts are risky.
Maria C: next steps: draft RFC with interfaces, metrics contract, and ops playbook for rollback. @deploy-bot can you create a RFC PR template? :slightly_smiling_face:
deploy-bot: RFC ticket created: https://git.internal/r/escrow-pilot-rfc — assigned to Maria C
Oncall Bot: FYI tagged incident runbook entries: pilot rollback -> runbook v2, page 4. reactions: :thumbsup:
Maria C: thanks — will draft RFC this week, will ping infra for cost estimate.
